Game Overview

At its heart, Tile Match Mania is a match-3 game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Tile Match Mania is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Tile Match Mania?

Tile Match Mania is a free match-3 game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Tile Match Mania free to play?

Yes, Tile Match Mania is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
